articles.title: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, Dell also say 'no' to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading plan
articles.snippet: Nearly half the companies on the venture’s original roster have now objected to their shares trading on the planned blockchain-based venue.

articles.title: XRP Ledger developers propose creating wallets with zero XRP for stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: An experimental change would let companies cover the reserve for customer and AI-agent accounts, allowing users to start with stablecoins without first acquiring XRP.

articles.title: Google to preview crypto custody security system as AI threats grow
articles.snippet: Google Multi-Party Compute is in private preview, with several major financial institutions testing the technology and parent company Alphabet using it to secure its own digital assets on Ethereum and Solana.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC
articles.snippet: The company said the accounting correction will cut reported assets by $92.2 million at the end of 2025 after bitcoin held on Biconomy could not be withdrawn.

articles.title: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks
articles.snippet: The largest Bitcoin treasury company will begin daily dividend payments on STRC in November, with three other preferred securities following in January 2027.
